_meta.purpose: Fresh held-out validation set for NEXT ② (judge V3->V4 hardening on subject/scope TRANSPLANT). Deliberately DISJOINT from the frozen 35-case judge_acceptance_cases.json so that tuning V4 to catch D01/GN10 does not fit-to-test. Score V4 candidates HERE for held-out generalization evidence; score the frozen 35 SEPARATELY for regression (answer-half must not drop, D00 veto must stay 否).
_meta.authored: S202 (2026-08-02), Phase A offline design. Queries + transplant_type + hypothesis authored WITHOUT any judge verdict and WITHOUT reading retrieved passages.
_meta.label_discipline: FINALIZED S202 Phase B step-1 (2026-08-02). Every `want` was set AFTER reading all 5 fetched passages. Result: 0 flips against pre-read hypothesis (7 transplant/gap = 否, 3 controls = 能). FT02 flagged BORDERLINE. Passages cached in judge_runs/chunks_cache_fresh_s202.json. Ready to score (Phase B step-2) once OPENAI_MODEL reconfirmed in Render dashboard.
_meta.transplant_defn: A TRANSPLANT = the corpus states a rule/figure for a DIFFERENT subject (e.g. staff vs student) or a DIFFERENT applicable scope (e.g. SCCC special centres vs ordinary KG) than the one asked. The item type matches; the subject/scope does not. Correct verdict = 否 even though a same-topic figure is present. This is the class V3 misses (D01 staff->student, GN10 SCCC->ordinary KG).
_meta.scoring: Same halves/false-answer discipline as the frozen set. A 能 on any hypothesis-否 case that reads as a true transplant after passage-read = a false answer (the exact defect V4 must fix). A 否 on an answer-control (FT-C*) = a recall regression (the exact risk of over-hardening).
run_plan_phase_B: 0. RECONFIRM OPENAI_MODEL in the Render dashboard before quoting any number (env.ts default gpt-4.1-nano != prod gpt-4o-mini).

6. REGRESSION: --score --prompt judge_prompts/v4a_s202.txt --label v4a-frozen35 --out judge_runs/2026-08-02_s202_v4a_frozen35.json  (repeat v4b; the frozen set uses its own default cases + cache)
7. GATE: answer-half on frozen-35 must stay 12/12; D00_s177_frozen_post must stay 否; false_answers reported apart from accuracy; then decide ship (C).
